[{:db/id 17592186124511 :knowledge-point/questions ["question-ea4581af-a083-51da-803f-0f83b3ed2ea6"] :db/ensure [:knowledge-point/validate]} {:db/id 17592186124863 :question/problem "Which of the following statements are true, given that $A$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix and 

$$
\text{Null}(A)=\{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]\,|\,{x}_{1}\in R\}?
$$

I. $\text{dim(Null}(A))=0$

II. $A$ is not invertible

III. $\text{rank}(A)=5$" :question/worked-solution "Since $A$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix, the invertible matrix theorem states the following:

$A$ is invertible $\,⇔\,\{\,\begin{aligned} & \text{Col}(A)={R}^{5} \\  & \text{dim(Col}(A))=5=\text{rank}(A) \\  & \text{Null}(A)=\{0\} \\  & \text{dim(Null}(A))=0=\text{nullity}(A)\end{aligned}$

With that in mind, let's examine each statement in turn.

- Statement I is false. Since 

$$
\text{Null}(A)=\{{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 0 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]\,|\,{x}_{1}\in R\}
$$

we conclude that 

$$
\text{dim(Null}(A))=1\ne 0.
$$

- Statement II is true. Since $\text{dim(Null}(A))\ne 0,$ then according to the invertible matrix theorem, the matrix $A$ can't be invertible.

- Statement III is false. Since $A$ is not invertible, then by the invertible matrix theorem, we must have $\text{rank}(A)\ne 5.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II only."" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186121778 :answer-field/correct 17592186121782 :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "question-ea4581af-a083-51da-803f-0f83b3ed2ea6" :question/id #uuid "ea4581af-a083-51da-803f-0f83b3ed2ea6" :question/math-academy-id "q-79349" :question/problem "Which of the following statements are true, given that $A$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix and  $det(A)=1?$ 

I. $A$ is not invertible

II. $\text{rank}(A)=4$

III. $A$ has $5$ pivot columns" :question/worked-solution "Since $A$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix, the invertible matrix theorem states the following:

$A$ is invertible $\,⇔\,\{\,\begin{aligned} & \text{Col}(A)={R}^{5} \\  & \text{dim(Col}(A))=5=\text{rank}(A) \\  & \text{Null}(A)=\{0\} \\  & \text{dim(Null}(A))=0=\text{nullity}(A)\end{aligned}$

With that in mind, let's examine each statement in turn. 

- Statement I is false. Indeed,   a matrix $A$ is invertible if and only if $det(A)\ne 0.$ Since here we have $det(A)=1\ne 0,$ our matrix $A$ must be  invertible.

- Statement II is false. Indeed, by the invertible matrix theorem
$A$ is invertible $\,⇔\,\text{rank}(A)=5.$

- Statement III is true. Since $\text{rank}(A)=5$,  it must be $\text{dim(Col}(A))=5$ which, in turn, means that  $A$ has $5$ pivot columns.

Therefore, the correct answer is "III only."" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-7e9f16a7-f4b2-5dc6-b4b7-1d7e51e453fc"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-7e9f16a7-f4b2-5dc6-b4b7-1d7e51e453fc" :answer-field/id #uuid "7e9f16a7-f4b2-5dc6-b4b7-1d7e51e453fc" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-7c2003c1-be5a-5ec0-8d3f-914e8ee86a4a" :answer-field/choices ["answer-75acd049-7010-5a98-8813-f29e53e8c979" "answer-46090913-fe8a-53d8-a2e2-1edec9407dcb" "answer-293235d4-a2f2-5777-a667-1540f003765f" "answer-596e4b3c-1fd0-573a-82a9-d1617135d478" "answer-7c2003c1-be5a-5ec0-8d3f-914e8ee86a4a"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-75acd049-7010-5a98-8813-f29e53e8c979" :answer/id #uuid "75acd049-7010-5a98-8813-f29e53e8c979" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "I and II only" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-46090913-fe8a-53d8-a2e2-1edec9407dcb" :answer/id #uuid "46090913-fe8a-53d8-a2e2-1edec9407dcb" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "I only" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-293235d4-a2f2-5777-a667-1540f003765f" :answer/id #uuid "293235d4-a2f2-5777-a667-1540f003765f" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "II and III only" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-596e4b3c-1fd0-573a-82a9-d1617135d478" :answer/id #uuid "596e4b3c-1fd0-573a-82a9-d1617135d478" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "II only" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-7c2003c1-be5a-5ec0-8d3f-914e8ee86a4a" :answer/id #uuid "7c2003c1-be5a-5ec0-8d3f-914e8ee86a4a" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "III only" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186272239 :question/problem "Which of the following statements are true, given that $A$ is a $6\times 6$ matrix and  $det(A)=-1?$
